title: Sold: Westport’s 40m motor yacht Seaquest
description: Westport Yachts’ 39.62-metre motor yacht Seaquest sold in Florida, the United States, after being on the market for less than three months. Ralph Navarro of Florida Yachts International (FYI) introduced the buyer, while Raymond Young of RJC Yacht Sales & Charter represented the seller.
html:
Written by Alexander Griffiths

Westport Yachts’ 39.62-metre motor yacht Seaquest sold in Florida, the United States, after being on the market for less than three months.

Ralph Navarro of Florida Yachts International (FYI) introduced the buyer, while Raymond Young of RJC Yacht Sales & Charter represented the seller.

Seaquest was delivered in 2004 and completed her most recent maintenance appointment last year, with Broward Marine in Florida. The motor yacht features an exterior design by her builder and naval architecture by William Garden. The task of curating her 298 GT of interior volume was entrusted to Pacific Custom Interiors.

With a five-stateroom configuration, comprising an owner’s suite, two doubles and two twins, Seaquest can accommodate as many as 10 guests. She can also carry seven crew.

In terms of performance, Westport Yachts equipped her with twin MTU engines that deliver a cruising speed of 24 knots and a top speed of 28 knots. She was asking $11,600,000 at the time of her sale.
